summary: MPI assigns contiguous row ranges together with matching nonzero intervals and rebased local delimiters. The stub forwards the row-kernel arguments to cudaLaunchKernel. Final SASS assigns one row per thread, scans its delimiter interval with scalar/unrolled chunks and remainder, then stores the row result.
